findings: Style note: step 1 "click Photo / Video on the post in the AI Agent" skips the page's earlier steps (add context, type a prompt naming the platforms, press Enter), so a new customer may not yet see a post to click on; the Next step asks which path they want before going further, so nothing goes wrong.
Style note: the reply never says to "Schedule or publish" after attaching, so the success line "the video shows attached to your post" is only a midpoint.
